defects_argued.quote: much prior to the time when this issue was rectified by the Department, it is deemed appropriate to set aside the impugned order

outcome.quote: remand the matter back to the Adjudicating Authority for it to be heard on merits

annotation.notes: Service mode is the petitioner's allegation (para 4) which the court accepts by applying earlier rulings (para 5, quoted, and para 6). Para 5 quotes other judgments (Neelgiri Machinery, which quotes ACE Cardiopathy and others): ignore their facts. Para 3 quotes the court's own earlier order in this case asking when the petitioner learnt of the order. Disposition 'disposed' but in substance the taxpayer won (order set aside, remanded).
